cohort: Laboring women with oxytocin infusion were categorized into three groups based on BMI: non-obesity (BMI 18.5-29.9, n = 12), obesity (BMI 30.0-34.9, n = 13), and morbid obesity (BMI > 35.0, n = 15).
finding: A low positive correlation between OT levels and BMI and significantly increased plasma OT levels in women with morbid obesity at an OT infusion rate of 3.3 mU/min were observed, but otherwise, no significant differences in OT levels between BMI groups or dose-dependent increase of OT levels were found.
cross-section timing: Serial plasma samples taken during labor with oxytocin infusion.
